title: Langflow Instance Parameters
description: Parameters for provisioning a Langflow IDE instance

cluster_url.description: Target cluster server URL (optional, defaults to broker's cluster). Must be a registered ArgoCD cluster.

superuser_password.description: Langflow admin password. Auto-generated if not provided.

secret_key.description: Encryption key for stored credentials and flow secrets. Must be at least 32 characters. Leave blank to auto-generate a secure 64-character key.
